notes.note: HHK was on field for many coaches covering for NAS but didn't really deliver what we wanted from his 20 disposals. His scoring wasn't higher as his disposals didn't have a big impact on the game.
Hugo was an ok cover again this week with his 17 disposals at 82%. He didn't have a huge game but it was tricky conditions.
Hugo was solid without being huge. 18 touches and a goal as he was cover for many Milera owners.
Many played HHK on field or looped him for Holmes and he delivered us a 54 from his 19 disposals which came at just 68% efficiency. No need to move him on but loop where you can.

HHK was back and hopefully you had him on field or at least looped on with his 18 disposals and 7 contested possessions putting up a solid score in the wet.  If you need him he could be your Holmes cover.
Hugo is certainly a player you should be considering looping off your bench each week where you are able. He will be on field for a lot of Whitfield owners this week.
While this was his lowest score of the season so far it wasn't the worst in the game. He will be a valuable hold for you if you can with him being able to cover two positions on your bench.
Hall-Kahan took 9 marks and had 23 disposals as he continues his great form and shows that he was certainly a must have from the mid season rookies.
